integrity: Finite face enumeration, global acyclic Morse matching, exact integral signed Morse boundary and Smith reduction, with independent characteristic-two, -three and -five original-boundary rank cross-checks. Mathematical argument and executable verification are included.
limitations: The result classifies the ordinary integral homotopy type for the single Paley graph of order thirteen; it does not classify larger orders, other Čech radii, persistent homology or equivariant homotopy. Unindexed equivalent calculations remain possible.
title: An integral Moore summand in the closed-neighborhood complex of the Paley graph of order 13
